name: Standing Our Ground

faq.answer: Aamelia Windfield gives you one last chance to retreat before you face the bandit leader.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Standing Our Ground?

aliases: who is the bandit leader standing our ground
faq.answer: You face the bandit leader threatening the local defenders. Aamelia gathers her resolve and confronts the leader with you.
faq.q: Who do you fight in Standing Our Ground?

aliases: where is valanaar standing our ground
faq.answer: Valanaar is the nearby settlement where Aamelia offers you a chance to retreat if you do not want to risk your life in the fight.
faq.q: What is Valanaar in relation to this quest?

aliases: why is standing our ground a lost cause
faq.answer: Aamelia and her companions believe the odds are against them. They see the standoff as a desperate last stand, and survival seems almost impossible without outside help.
faq.q: Why does Aamelia describe the battle as a lost cause?

aliases: what happens after beating bandit leader standing our ground
faq.answer: The bandit leader is defeated. Aamelia Windfield is shocked and relieved that the ordeal is over, and struggles to steady her racing heart.
faq.q: What happens once the confrontation is over?

faq.answer: You helped the defenders prepare for the bandit threat, giving them a fighting chance before the final confrontation.
faq.q: What leads up to this final stand?

sections.body: Aamelia Windfield gives you one last chance to return safely to Valanaar. You have helped the local defenders prepare for the bandits, but the fight ahead looks grim. Will you stand with them, or leave before the clash?
sections.title: A Desperate Last Stand

sections.body: When you signal that you are ready, you go with Aamelia Windfield to face the bandit leader. Defeating the brigand ends the immediate threat. Aamelia can hardly catch her breath, shocked and relieved that their gamble succeeded.
sections.title: Confronting the Bandit Leader

summary: Aamelia Windfield gives you one last chance to retreat to Valanaar before the bandits close in. You have helped the local defenders prepare, yet the coming fight still seems doomed.
attribution: In-game quest text: Standing Our Ground
